In Path of Exile 1: Covens of Umbra, we’re introducing two new gems and making changes to some of the existing ones.

We’ve prepared the gem data at level 20 with 20% quality for all new and changed gems. Check them out!

New Gems

Updated Gems
Show All DifferencesHide All Differences

Flame Link

Modified

New: Linked target gains 219 to 329 Added Fire Damage

Old: Linked target gains 169 to 254 Added Fire Damage

New: Linked target gains Added Fire Damage equal to 3% of your Maximum Life

Old: Linked target gains Added Fire Damage equal to 5% of your Maximum Life

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Summon Flame Golem

Modified

New: Golems grant 24% increased Damage

Old: Golems grant 29% increased Damage

New: Golems grant 15% increased Area of Effect

Old: Golems grant 20% increased Area of Effect

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Summon Stone Golem

Modified

New: Golems grant 16% increased Defences

Old: Golems grant 20% increased Defences

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Dark Bargain

New: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain beams to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.

Old: This spell removes some life from one of your Skeleton minions near you or the targeted location to deal chaos damage in an area around it. This effect will chain to your other nearby skeletons. If you have no skeletons near you or the targeted location, it will sacrifice your own life to deal damage instead.

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Pact of Beidat

Modified

New: Beams from Empowered Skills Chain 4 additional times

Old: Beams from Empowered Skills Chain 6 additional times

New: Empowered Skills fire 4 additional Projectiles Empowered Skills fire Projectiles in a circle

Old: Empowered Skills fire 6 additional Projectiles Empowered Skills fire Projectiles in a circle

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Summon Lightning Golem

Modified

New: Golems grant 8% increased Attack and Cast Speed

Old: Golems grant 10% increased Attack and Cast Speed

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Winter Orb

Modified

New: Effectiveness of Added Damage 70%

Old: Effectiveness of Added Damage 80%

New: Deals 307 to 460 Cold Damage

Old: Deals 360 to 539 Cold Damage

New: Fires 2 Projectiles

Old: Fires 3 Projectiles

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Transfusion Support

Added

A Minion within 6 metres gains a Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charge for every 400 Life you spend on Upfront Costs with Supported Spells

Removed

A nearby Minion gains a Soul for every 200 Life you spend on Upfront Costs with Supported Spells

New: Supports spells. Does not support instant or blessing spells.

Old: Supports non-blessing spells.

Show DifferencesHide Differences

Vaal Sacrifice Support

Added

Supported Skills Sacrifice all but 20% of your maximum Life and Energy Shield on Use

Removed

Supported Skills Sacrifice all but 1 of your Life and Energy Shield on Use
